test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

1724, 1716, 1689, 1625, 1500, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1724 - 8 = 1716

1716 - 27 = 1689

1689 - 64 = 1625

1625 - 125 = 1500

**1500 - 216 = 1284**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/032346cf888e1425864808c55c64368a96cd0d91fe9bad486be5279d3989be83.png] 

Hence, **1284** is the correct answer.
